'''Brian Terwilliger''' (Players Committee forum name '''Twigg''', also listed as Brian Twigg; X '''eltwigg''') is a core member of [[Team Albany]]. He played the [[2020 World Championship]] and was runner-up at the [[2014 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-world-championships/ 2020 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref> He is a two-time New York State Champion and Boston Grand Slam Champion.<ref name="clone1">[https://media.swccgstore.com/2018/09/03/the-voice-of-the-force-interview-with-swccg-documentary-directors/ The Voice of the Force: Interview with SWCCG Documentary Directors], Clone 1 with Brian Terwilliger and Brandon Baity, SWCCG Store (3 September 2018). "We randomly stumbled upon a shop in a dingy mall and met a guy name Johnny Chu (he traded me an IG-2000 for my Avenger; lol). He told us about a group of players who had events weekly. A few months later we moved to the Capital Region and joined the likes of Matt Sokol, Aaron Kingery and Mike D’amboise… ‘Team Albany’ was born."</ref>

[[File:Brian Terwilliger DecipherCon 2000.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Brian Terwilliger at [[DecipherCon 2000]] after [[Team Albany]] won the Star Wars CCG team championship]]

At [[DecipherCon 2000]] he won Sunday's four-player team championship with [[Matt Sokol]], [[Jonny Chu]], and [[Chris Terwilliger]].<ref name="eltwigg">[https://x.com/eltwigg/status/1327604566830043142 Brian Terwilliger], X (14 November 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201114133100/https://twitter.com/eltwigg/status/1327604566830043142 Wayback Machine]; [https://archive.ph/Hm5mO archive.today].</ref>
He said the 2000 team title would always be his favorite, even though 2014 Worlds runner-up was his best solo result.<ref name="clone1" />

He is the brother of [[Chris Terwilliger]]. Chris bought Brian his first [[Princess Leia]] from [[Cloud City Limited|Cloud City]], snuck it into Brian's Light mains deck, and dealt Brian a starting hand with her waiting.<ref name="leia">[https://x.com/eltwigg/status/1417764733378187270 Brian Terwilliger], X (21 July 2021). "My brother bought me my first Princess Leia from this set, snuck it into my light side mains deck, demanded we play at 11pm and dealt my starting hand where she was waiting for me. Won't ever forget this @LittleTwigg. Best Swccg bros 4 life." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210721083400/https://twitter.com/eltwigg/status/1417764733378187270 Wayback Machine].</ref>

He co-produced the documentary ''One With The Force: The Rise, Fall, and Rebirth of the Star Wars CCG'' with Brandon Baity.<ref name="clone1" /><ref name="gofundme">[https://www.gofundme.com/f/nq22y-star-wars-ccg-documentary Star Wars CCG Documentary], GoFundMe (started 16 December 2017).</ref>
